description: The channels of the connected Slack workspace that alerts can post to: every public channel, plus each private channel the Mentio bot was added to (in Slack, /invite @Mentio). privateChannels false means the workspace was connected before Mentio could see private channels: reconnect Slack once in the dashboard (Settings, Integrations). Pass a channel id and name to create_channel.
name: list_slack_channels
title: List slack channels
